title: c07 on C:swim-divide: phase_swimdiv + link ring (chi) + a label-free kernel-averaged phoretic drive, from noise
summary: Route of Q:membrane-swimmer-divider. (a) phase_swimdiv with phase_membrane's chi ring, from noise; (b) replace the per-label drift by a local, label-free velocity v = G*(phi^2 mu grad S) / G*(phi^2) with a kernel wider than a cell, so the drive is a near-rigid translation that the Allen-Cahn wall can carry. Readouts: rim/core L, body lengths, persistent splits, ring in daughters; chi=0 and mu=0 twins.
